svg.text: Case 11 — what offside trimming removes near the two source cusps
Gray: source · Blue: retained · Red: rejected by side classification · Orange: eligible, but absent from closed walks
Dots: source cusps at x = 150 and 165.
The corrected radius-9 joins extend below both cusp tips. Each crosses the source and is cut into pieces.
Red pieces lie on the rejected side of the source. Orange pieces pass that test but cannot join a retained closed walk.
No cusp trimming has run in panel 3. The join geometry has already been lost at this stage.
